sections.shortTitle: Federal Public Service Commission Composition and Conditions of Service Regulations 1978
sections.section: RULE - Federal Public Service Commission (Composition and Conditions of Service) Regulations 1978
sections.description:
FEDERAL PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
FEDERAL PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION
(COMPOSITION AND
CONDITIONS OF
SERVICE) REGULATIONS,
1978
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
13th August, 2009]
S.R.O. 723(I)/2009, dated 11-8-2009.---In
exercise of the powers conferred by subsection (2) of section 3 of he Federal
Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1977 (XLV of 1977), the President is
pleased to direct that the following further amendments shall be made in the
Federal Public Service Commission (Composition and Conditions of Service)
Regulations, 1978, namely:--,
In aforesaid Regulations,--
(a) regulations 5, 6, 7 and 8 shall be
omitted; and
(b) in Schedule I, in serial No.14 in the
first column, in the second column the word "Medical" shall be
omitted.
